summary.text: Donavon Hawk is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has served since 2021 and now represents District 72; he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes work as public relations and marketing coordinator for the Butte YMCA.

paragraphs.text: Hawk studied at Montana Technological University.
He worked as the public relations and marketing coordinator with the Butte YMCA and has volunteered with SEIU, Montana Organizing Project and Praxis Project.
Hawk won the District 76 House seat in 2020 and was re-elected in 2022, then won District 72 in 2024.

For 2025-2026 he is vice chair of the House Ethics Committee and is assigned to the Rules and Appropriations committees; earlier assignments included the Judiciary, Human Services, Legislative Administration, Local Government and Education committees.
